QFuture<QVariant> WebioPlugin::httpGet(Q.name: webio/http_get
QFuture<QVariant> WebioPlugin::httpGet(Q.title: HTTP GET
QFuture<QVariant> WebioPlugin::httpGet(Q.description: Perform a raw HTTP GET request. The result resolves to the status code, response headers, body, and redirect location. The response body is returned verbatim and is not parsed.

url.description: The full URL to request (must start with http:// or https://).

headers.description: Optional request headers as a JSON object of string values.

QFuture<QVariant> WebioPlugin::httpPost(.name: webio/http_post_form
QFuture<QVariant> WebioPlugin::httpPost(.title: HTTP POST form
QFuture<QVariant> WebioPlugin::httpPost(.description: Submit an application/x-www-form-urlencoded POST request. The result resolves to the status code, response headers, body, and redirect location. The response body is returned verbatim and is not parsed.

url.description: The full URL to request (must start with http:// or https://).

form.description: Form fields as a JSON object of string values.

headers.description: Optional request headers as a JSON object of string values.
